title: Add Grafana dashboard templates for SCM service metrics + mismatch detectors
author: Allison Grant
description: Summary: Adds curated Grafana dashboard JSON templates for the Standard Cost Model (SCM) cost-model-service, plus a companion dashboard for "mismatch detectors" comparing SCM estimates vs metered attribution. These templates are intended to be imported by SRE/Platform teams during staged rollout and used as the baseline for alert tuning. Motivation: We need consistent, low-cardinality views of SCM health across regions and deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and a single place to monitor drift between estimated vs metered attribution (used by Console/Optimize) without requiring per-team custom dashboard work. Scope: (1) Service health dashboard: request volume, success/error rates, latency percentiles, validation failures by reason, version negotiation failures, and downstream dependency timing (model-catalog + telemetry reads). (2) Economics signal dashboard: cache hit-rate (KV + prefix, where emitted), batch_size_effective distributions, prefill/decode splits, quant_profile_id coverage, and confidence score distributions. (3) Mismatch detectors dashboard: estimate_vs_metered_total delta (absolute + %), breakdown component deltas (compute/memory/cache credits), drift by model_family, by gpu_sku, and by region with explicit "coverage" panels showing how much data is being compared (to avoid false confidence when telemetry is missing). Notes on design: Dashboards use standard variables (region, env, deployment_mode, tenant_tier, model_family, gpu_sku) with guardrails: default to aggregated views and limit high-cardinality label combinations. Templates assume Prometheus data source name "Prometheus" and metrics naming conventions from the cost-model-service instrumentation. Rollout: Intended to be deployed alongside SCM canary checks and SLO dashboards; alerts are not included in this PR (handled in redwood PR-18602 and follow-ups) but the panels align with those alert thresholds. Related: ENG-23217, perf-canary PR-421 (drift checks), redwood PR-18602 (SLO dashboards/alerts).

docs: add import notes + expected data sources

conversation: Sean Gallagher: Panels look good. Can we add a view that isolates client timeouts vs server timeouts? We’ve seen Console degrade when SCM p99 spikes and retries pile up.

Allison Grant: Added a dedicated panel for server-side 5xx vs upstream timeout bucket (grpc_status=DEADLINE_EXCEEDED where available) and a note in README on interpreting it; also added a panel for request_duration_seconds p99 alongside gateway latency to spot client-side timeouts.
Logan Wright: Please ensure we’re not templating on tenant_id anywhere. Also, quant_profile_id can be extremely high-cardinality depending on how runtime emits it.

Allison Grant: Confirmed no tenant_id dimension in any query. quant_profile_id is only shown as a coverage % panel (present/missing) and a top-N panel is removed; README calls out that any per-profile breakdown should be done in the telemetry warehouse, not Grafana.

Rafael Mendes: For mismatch detectors, I’d like a coverage panel that shows the denominator explicitly (number of comparisons) so drift doesn’t look stable on sparse data. Also, can we split by estimate mode (estimate vs explain/attribution)?

Allison Grant: Added 'comparison_count' stat and a time series panel for comparisons per minute. Also added a variable + panel group split by scm_request_kind (estimate|explain) where metrics exist; falls back gracefully if the label is absent.
Nadia Rahman: The validation failures panel is helpful—can we break out "missing region" separately? That was the main cause in the oncall thread last week.
Allison Grant: Added a dedicated panel for validation_error_reason with a focus on missing_region / missing_gpu_sku / unknown_model, and set those as the default legend entries.
Sean Gallagher: Approving. Please add a short note to the changelog that these are templates only and not automatically deployed.
Allison Grant: Done in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased.
release_notes: Adds importable Grafana dashboard templates for SCM cost-model-service health/economics signals and estimate-vs-metered mismatch detection; templates only (no automatic deployment).
